title: Cross-peer failure taxonomy and implementation-readiness reconciliation
mode: Primary-source issue/documentation review with local source/test inventory; no peer runtime
scope: Refresh recent LibreDWG and ACadSharp failure reports across DWG modeler payloads, value fidelity, DXF object ordering, string integrity, and strict-consumer acceptance.
Cross-check each report against Autodesk/ODA references and current local test owners without inferring matching libdxfrw defects.
Refine implementation-ready gates while preserving fast per-slice validation, scratch/repository-owned fixture policy, and non-promoting external evidence.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-02; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open.
sources.observed: The author reports an R2018 generated DXF REGION with a 5,489-byte ezdxf-authored SAB payload losing its AcDs records and body after LibreDWG DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF conversion; a separate confidential AutoCAD drawing is also described.
sources.limits: This is a peer report and a same-codec round trip; ezdxf payload generation does not establish independent B-rep semantics. The confidential drawing was not obtained and no peer executable was run.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-08; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open.
sources.observed: The author describes a C string-quoting path that terminates at buffer capacity, then measures with strlen, allowing allocator residue into DXF output; allocator perturbation is used in the reporter's reproduction.
sources.limits: The described implementation is LibreDWG's C buffer path. Local libdxfrw source uses length-aware string writes in the audited writer route; no analogous local mechanism was reproduced.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-08; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open.
sources.observed: The author reports an extension DICTIONARY at handle 3 and owner 2 emitted before the NOD at handle B and owner 0; a reader that treats the first OBJECTS record as root then selects the wrong dictionary.
sources.limits: The peer reproducer was not run here. This is about DXF serialization position, not DWG NOD discovery by array order or minimum handle.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-08; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open/question.
sources.observed: The report contrasts TV and TU string conversion paths for literal \U+XXXX content while targeting modern DXF and identifies lone-surrogate UTF-8 validity as a separate concern.
sources.limits: The report asks about intended policy and is not a normative source or independent result. No peer corpus or patch was run.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-08; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open.
sources.observed: The author reports CMC method confusion between packed ACI (0xC3) and RGB (0xC2), palette collisions, and a true-color low-byte fallback that can emit invalid group 62 zero; the author later corrected an initial proposed guard after identifying the R2004+ BS index as vestigial for this route.
sources.limits: Peer analysis and corpus measurements were not independently run. ODA v5.4.1 §2.11 and local generated controls remain the applicable evidence for libdxfrw.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-09-13; mutable issue page and comments reviewed 2026-10-20; open with no linked PR shown.
sources.observed: The report describes AutoCAD rejection of ACadSharp 3.6.35 DXF output across CLASSES, HATCH, and DIMSTYLE cases. A later comment narrows the HATCH observation: TrueView required group 47 on derived-boundary paths (flag 92=7), so the original simple zero-value omission proposal is not a universal predicate.
sources.limits: The reports are profile- and version-specific; raw producer output was not independently inspected and no native app was run. The HATCH group-47 presence condition remains unresolved locally.

sources.revision: Issue opened 2026-10-14; mutable issue page reviewed 2026-10-20 and shown open.
sources.observed: A user reports that a DWG-to-DXF output from ACadSharp 3.8.0 is rejected by GDAL as bad spline data and cites an external AI-generated explanation.
sources.limits: The issue attachments were not downloaded; the cited explanation is not technical authority. GDAL is a downstream parser/projection route and its rejection alone does not establish a format violation or libdxfrw defect.

sources.project: Autodesk DXF OBJECTS section reference and ezdxf OBJECTS internals
sources.revision: Official Autodesk reference and mutable ezdxf documentation reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The references support the positional NOD-first OBJECTS convention and distinguish object ownership from physical position.
sources.limits: The reviewed references do not unambiguously establish a universal parent-before-child order for every OBJECTS record. Keep exact order checks scoped to a local writer invariant or pinned consumer requirement; do not infer DWG root identity from physical order.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw source and test inventory
sources.observed: Existing owners cover NOD-first/owner-before-child output, ODA-shaped C2/C3 CMC values, TV/TU source and target text characterization, and exact string framing/transactionality. The local plan separately tracks AcDs carrier closure and strict-consumer gates.
sources.limits: This is source/test inspection only; no tests or peer/native executables were run in this research pass.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8: keep AcDs carrier association, object/owner closure, payload preservation, and independent geometry semantics as separate evidence stages.
PAR-20/7G.3: retain actual NOD identity and required first-record/owner ordering as separate graph/output assertions.
PAR-66/7AN: reuse method-discriminated CMC controls; do not infer ACI from palette RGB or the reserved R2004+ index.
PAR-05/7AR: keep TV/TU source storage, target DXF version, field kind, raw bytes, and semantic text as separate dimensions.
PAR-14/PAR-76: keep exact-length string framing, binary/ASCII mode, strict consumer acceptance, and rollback distinct.
PAR-05/7BQ.5: preserve profile-specific native acceptance candidates and the unresolved HATCH group-47 presence predicate.

planChanges: Added a newest-research summary plus a consolidated failure-stage crosswalk covering recently reviewed LibreDWG and ACadSharp reports.
Reconciled the reports with existing local source/test owners and retained current implementation order, fast-test cadence, and fixture policy.
Kept issue reports, release behavior, native acceptance, carrier preservation, and semantic geometry evidence in separate evidence classes.
limitations: GitHub issue pages are mutable and report peer observations; no peer repository was built or run.
No linked customer/peer drawings were downloaded; no strict external parser or native CAD application was invoked.
Local conclusions are source/test inventory only and do not constitute test execution or support qualification.
